$comment: Release 0.0.20 performance budgets (Phase 3 progressive disclosure). Baselines measured 2026-07-31, Node v24.18.0, Linux x86_64. Pack bytes/file count are deterministic -> tight tolerance. Startup and benchmark medians are machine-dependent -> generous ceiling/tolerance to stay non-flaky. Enforced by scripts/budget-gate.test.mjs (fast, in `npm test`: root pack + startup) and scripts/benchmark-0.0.16.mjs (release evidence: the six scenario medians). A regression beyond tolerance fails the gate.

aggregate.$comment: Sum of `npm pack --dry-run` sizes across all 44 publishable manifests (root + 43 packages). Recorded reference baseline; not gated in the fast test (43 extra pack calls are too slow for a unit gate).

startup.$comment: Cold-process `import('./dist/index.js')` wall time. Baseline ~37ms; the ceiling is a non-flaky sanity bound that catches catastrophic startup regression, not a tight per-machine target.

benchmarkMedians.$comment: Network-free scenario medians from scripts/benchmark-0.0.15.mjs (100 iterations), reused unchanged by benchmark-0.0.16.mjs (0.0.16 added no performance-affecting code). Throughput regression = measured < baseline*(1-tolerance); latency regression = measured > baseline*(1+tolerance).
